patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-impact photography and video stills are used as dominant section backgrounds, often in black and white or muted tones, creating a strong visual presence.
Sections are frequently separated by large, solid blocks of black or a single accent color, providing stark visual breaks and a sense of depth.
Extreme contrast in typography, featuring massive, condensed, uppercase sans-serif headings that dominate their sections, paired with much smaller, refined sans-serif text for details and navigation.
A high-contrast, limited color palette primarily uses black and white, with occasional muted sepia tones and a single strong, earthy reddish-brown accent color.
Large background images (e.g., hero video stills) exhibit a subtle parallax effect, scrolling at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a layered depth.

A global sticky header remains visible at the very top of the viewport, while certain section-specific elements (like 'PSYCHO FILMS' and its navigation) also stick to the top of their respective sections as they scroll into view, then disappear with the section.
A horizontal scrolling gallery of images is embedded within a vertically scrolling section, allowing for a dynamic content presentation.

technique_notes: Implement a persistent global header that remains fixed at the top of the viewport throughout the page scroll.
Create section-specific sticky elements that attach to the top of their parent section as it enters the viewport and scroll away once the section fully exits, using scroll-triggered positioning.
Achieve a subtle parallax effect for large background images by having them scroll at a slower rate than the main page content, giving a sense of depth and layering.

design_tokens.type_scale: Massive, condensed, uppercase headings (~5-8x body) create strong visual anchors, contrasted with small, clean sans-serif text for navigation and details.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — generous vertical spacing between sections and around hero elements, creating a spacious and uncrowded feel.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its bold, almost brutalist use of typography and high-contrast imagery. The blend of full-bleed, often black and white, cinematic visuals with stark black sections and a single, strong accent color creates a powerful, editorial aesthetic. The layered scrolling and embedded horizontal galleries add a sophisticated, interactive dimension that elevates it beyond a typical portfolio.
